en.headline: Yellow Bus ends nearly 30-year service as new Huanggang Port opens
en.dek: The last northbound Yellow Bus to the old port leaves San Tin between 6.15am and 6.20am today, after which the cross-boundary shuttle is retired under the new joint-clearance arrangements.
body: The Lok Ma Chau-Huanggang Yellow Bus, which has shuttled passengers between San Tin and the original port for nearly three decades, will run its final services early this morning as the redeveloped Huanggang Port begins 24-hour operations at 6.30am.

According to the Transport Department, the last northbound Yellow Bus to the old Huanggang Port will depart from San Tin Public Transport Interchange between 6.15am and 6.20am. The final southbound service will leave only after all travellers who entered the old port before 6.30am have completed clearance and boarded.

From today, passengers will no longer need the shuttle. New franchised bus and green minibus routes will serve the redeveloped port directly, while the original Lok Ma Chau Control Point passenger services are suspended. The Yellow Bus fleet is expected to be redeployed to other non-franchised services.

Bus enthusiasts and regular cross-boundary travellers marked the final day of the service on Sunday, with some waiting overnight at the terminus to photograph the last departures. The Yellow Bus began operations in 1997 and became a familiar part of the boundary crossing for generations of commuters.

zh.headline: 皇巴近30年服務今早結束 新皇崗口岸啟用
zh.dek: 往舊口岸北行尾班皇巴於今早6時15分至6時20分由新田開出，此後接駁服務將告終，改由新口岸一地兩檢安排取代。
body: 服務近三十年的落馬洲-皇崗皇巴，今早將開出最後班次，隨著重建後的皇崗口岸於上午6時30分正式啟用24小時通關服務而結束歷史任務。
運輸署表示，前往舊皇崗口岸的北行尾班皇巴將於上午6時15分至6時20分由新田公共運輸交匯處開出。南行尾班車則待所有在上午6時30分前進入舊口岸的旅客完成清關及登車後才開出。
由今日起，旅客毋須再轉乘接駁巴士。多條全新或延長的專營巴士及專線小巴路線將直接服務新皇崗口岸，落馬洲管制站的旅檢服務亦同時停用。皇巴車隊預期會改作其他非專營巴士服務。
巴士迷及常客於周日最後一天到場拍照留念，部分人更通宵守候尾班車。皇巴於1997年投入服務，一直是跨境人士熟悉的接駁工具。
